game.q: an emperor comes to meet the third guru. where does he sit first?
opts: on a raised seat by the guru
on the floor, in the row
in a tent of his own

wrong.raised: makes sense for an emperor. not here.
wrong.tent: no private room. everyone eats together.

game.right: YES. sikh tradition says he sat on the floor with everyone, for the same meal.

end.line: his father wanted a good deal. nanak fed hungry holy men, the truest deal there is.
